## Flagship 0-to-1 Builds & Architecture Deep-Dives

### 1. Legal Owl — AI-Native Legal Workflow Platform
- **Problem**: Litigators spend 20+ hours weekly manually tracking hearing schedules across disparate Indian court portals and summarizing dense case documents without hallucination guarantees.
- **Solution**: Built a 4-pillar legal-tech platform:
  1. *Live Docket Sync*: Direct integration with eCourts India APIs using CNR tracking and automated nightly event diffing.
  2. *Cause List Ingestion*: PDF parsing pipeline that extracts cause lists and maps next hearing dates to lawyer calendars.
  3. *Multi-Agent Legal Research*: Schema-locked multi-agents with an 'approve-before-act' trust gate.
  4. *Zero-Hallucination Citation Ledger*: Bounding-box coordinate citation linking generated legal arguments directly to source document spans.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Supabase pgvector, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, Tailwind CSS, eCourts India API.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/yb0203/LegalOwl

### 2. GitaBae — Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Wisdom Engine
- **Problem**: Standard generative models hallucinate verses and deliver generic advice when queried for nuanced philosophical wisdom.
- **Solution**: Designed an end-to-end RAG system featuring semantic text chunking, embedding similarity scoring with Pinecone, multi-turn conversational memory, and strict confidence gating that abstains unless citations meet high thresholds.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, LangChain, Pinecone Vector DB, OpenAI GPT-4, Streamlit.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/yb0203/GitaBae

### 3. Vibe Check — Natural Language Git MCP Server
- **Problem**: Developers and autonomous agents often make syntax or merge errors when using terminal Git commands.
- **Solution**: Engineered a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that translates natural language developer intent into deterministic, safe Git operations with rollback guardrails and 95% intent resolution accuracy.
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, TypeScript, Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK, Git CLI.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/yb0203/vibe-check
